from_quote: By sect. 8 of article i, Congress are to have the unlimited right to regulate commerce

rationale: Following its citation of "sect. 8 of article i", the paragraph names the power to levy and collect imposts and taxes, which is that section's first clause.

from_quote: whether the national assembly was elected for seven years or for six
rationale: The paragraph names a six-year term of election under the new system, set against a seven-year parliament; the six-year term of senators is set in Article I, Section 3, clause 1.

from_quote: it proposes that a fictitious consent of only nine states shall be sufficient to establish it
rationale: The paragraph names the provision that the consent of nine states is sufficient to establish the Constitution, which is Article VII.
